startersHint: A starter sets how strongly the noise is reduced and what else is done. You can change it under More options.
soundHint: Add a voice note, a call recording or a video (its sound is used), or record now. Up to {max} minutes. Or try the sample, which has hiss and hum on purpose.
fileFailed: That file could not be read as sound. Try an MP3, M4A, WAV or a video file.
micBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow microphone access in your browser, or add a file instead.
tooLong: That recording is longer than {max} minutes. Cut it shorter first, then add it here.
noiseHint: The tool listens to the quietest parts to learn the noise, then turns it down. It works best when there are small pauses. Stronger settings can make a voice sound thinner.
rumbleHint: Cuts the very low sounds below 90 Hz, such as wind, desk knocks and traffic hum. Speech is not affected.
levelHint: Makes loud parts a little quieter and quiet parts easier to hear, so you do not need to keep changing the volume.
louderHint: Raises the whole recording as far as it can go without distortion.
silenceHint: Cut start and end removes the quiet bit before and after you speak. Long pauses over about one second are shortened but never fully removed.
tip: Listen with headphones to judge the result. If the voice sounds thin or watery, choose a lighter noise setting.
working: Cleaning up: {done}% done. Keep this page open.
failed: The audio could not be cleaned. Try a shorter recording or a lighter setting.
noiseResult: Voice above the background noise: {from} dB became {to} dB. Higher is cleaner.
peakResult: Loudest point: {from} became {to}. Closer to 0 dB is louder.
littleChange: The voice is not much clearer. Try a stronger setting, or the recording may not have small pauses for the tool to learn the noise from.
headphones: Play the original and the cleaned sound one after the other to hear the difference.
wavNote: WAV is full quality and works in editing apps, but the file is large.
smallNote: Saves a smaller file that is easier to share. It is recorded while the sound plays, so it takes as long as the audio. Keep this page open.
smallWorking: Recording a small file while the sound plays. Keep this page open.
smallFailed: The small file could not be made. You can still save the WAV file.
notSaved: Your audio is never uploaded. Only your settings are remembered on this device, not the sound.
